name: 涂地大作战
description: A real-time 2-4 player paint arena game built with Three.js and TypeScript. The Node server owns deterministic movement, painting, collisions, bombs, timing and scoring while clients predict locally from the same shared rules. Includes room invites, spectators, reconnect recovery, capability-negotiated WebRTC text and voice chat, and an end-to-end Chromium smoke test.
